messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

Use formal R&S VNA specifications for the exact R&S model, including model, order number, frequency range, connector type, and applicable test conditions [5][8][1].
Use only warranted or properly qualified specification data, because ZNL data without tolerance limits is not binding and is subject to change [1].
If using R&S ZNA67EXT, state the exact system configuration and limits, because its specifications apply only to the defined 1.0 mm VNA system configuration with matching rear-panel designation, serial numbers, and port positions [23].
Do not use sales battle cards as binding technical specifications, because the CMX500 competitor comparison page is sales positioning rather than binding technical specifications [9].
Do not rely on internal competitor claims alone, because claims about a competitor from a single R&S internal battle card should be checked against the competitor’s official data and third-party evidence before use in customer documents [6].
For any competitor VNA comparison, obtain the competitor’s official datasheet or equivalent formal source for the exact model, options, configurations, calibration status, measurement conditions, tolerances, and uncertainty; the passages show that missing datasheet numbers, hardware revisions, software versions, and detailed RF performance are explicit evidence gaps in competitor-related material [22].

answer.question: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

passages.text:
R&S ZNL20 › 文件與適用條件
- 相關來源：[[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNL Vector Network Analyzer，PD 3607.1071.22，Version 10.00，September 2025。
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下存放 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；內容 subject to change。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

amarisoft › 與 R&S 產品的對比脈絡
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]，R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主要差異化論點為：

- [[R&S CMX500]]：one-box [[NR FR1]] + [[NR FR2]] + [[Wi-Fi signaling]]，並支援 validated testing。
- [[R&S CMW500]]：legacy 2G/3G continuity。
- [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]]：production / ATE / non-signaling scaling path。
- R&S：global support、multi-year warranties、calibration labs、service contracts。
- R&S：PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests；來源稱 [[amarisoft]] functional only，not accepted for operator certification。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 使用限制
- 本頁不建立 RFU18 的正式產品規格；目前來源仍未提供 RFU18 order number、規格書文件編號、release date 或 supported configurations。
- **FR3** 的正式頻段定義、3GPP / 6G 標準版本、R&S option code 與 measurement bandwidth 仍缺正式標準 / 規格來源；目前 PR 說法為 proposed 7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz。
- Anritsu FR3 **0.4–16 GHz**、FR2 **43.5 GHz / 800 MHz / 5 Gbps** 等數字目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Anritsu 官方規格。
- Keysight UXM-P / RaySim / future hardware / software 的 FR3 / 6G path 目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Keysight 官方 roadmap。
- RFU18 up to **18 GHz** 同時出現在 battle card 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]；但 max aggregated NR bandwidth **2000 MHz** 目前仍只在 battle card 中出現。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 的 13 GHz demo 未提供 throughput、bandwidth、MCS index、MIMO layers、hardware configuration 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 的 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 未提供 carrier bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software version、RFU18 detailed specs 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。

R&S ZNL20 › 型號與訂購資訊
| 型號 | 原文說明 | Order No. |
|---|---|---:|
| R&S®ZNL20 | Vector network analyzer，20 GHz，3.5 mm connectors | 1323.0012.20 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 與既有 CMX500 正式規格的差異
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 不直接消除上述 battle card 與 formal specs 的矛盾；它只提供 PR 層級的 13 GHz demonstration claim。[[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 則提高了 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz 的可追溯性，但仍未提供 formal RFU18 specifications。

passages.text:
R&S ZNL20
[[R&S ZNL20]] 是 [[R&S ZNL]] 系列的 20 GHz 2-port Vector Network Analyzer，依 [[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]] Version 10.00（September 2025）標示，VNA frequency range 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz，test port connector 為 3.5 mm, male；加裝 [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 時 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張
[[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 指 R&S sales battle cards 中以 [[R&S CMX500]] / upcoming [[RFU18]] 對比競品 FR3 / 6G path 的銷售定位說法；它不是正式 RFU18 或 CMX500 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 另提供一個 PR / demonstration-level 來源，說 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 13 GHz 驗證 [[5G NR]] high-throughput performance，但該 PR 同樣不是 formal CMX500 / RFU18 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 進一步提供 PR 層級來源，明確把 new [[RFU18]] board、CMX500 coverage up to 18 GHz 與 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 連在一起；但它仍未提供 RFU18 formal datasheet、order number 或完整 test conditions。

|---|---|---:|
| R&S®ZNL6 | Vector network analyzer，6 GHz，N connectors | 1323.0012.06 |

Anritsu MD8190A › 產品定位
依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10，No. MX844030PC-J-A-1-(2.00)），[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 搭配 MD8190A-001 0.4-6GHz TRX RF Unit、[[MX819020A]] Virtual Signalling Tester RF Platform 與 MX819020A-020 RF Interface For NR RedCap，用於 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 的 real-time RF interface。

來源圖示中，Post-silicon Test Solution / Virtual ST Real-time 路徑包含 Linux PC、Windows PC、[[RTD]] control、SDR 與 shield box。

R&S ZNL6 › General data
- Display：26.4 cm 10.1 in diagonal WXGA color LCD with touchscreen；1280 × 800 × 262144。
- Internal data storage：standard solid-state drive 32 Gbyte nominal。
- Operating temperature range：+5 °C to +40 °C。
- Storage temperature range：–20 °C to +70 °C。
- Power consumption：depends on options installed；max. 300 W；90 W nominal。
- Dimensions：408 mm × 186 mm × 235 mm。
- Net weight：without options 6 kg；with internal battery 7.3 kg。

Anritsu MD8190A › 使用限制與未決事項
- 來源未標示 MD8190A 的 datasheet document number、硬體 revision 或 firmware / software version。
- 來源只在 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] brochure 中列出 MD8190A 的摘要規格；若需完整 RF performance、calibration、phase noise、EVM 或 timing specs，需另查 MD8190A 官方文件。
- 來源標示 QSEFP28，可能需與原 PDF 核對是否應為 QSFP28。

R&S ZNA67EXT › 系統構成與適用條件
依 [[ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900]]，[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] system consists of one [[R&S ZNA67]] vector network analyzer and up to four external test sets。

來源明確限制：規格只適用於作為 **1.0 mm vector network analyzer system** 操作，且 system configuration 必須與 [[R&S ZNA67]] rear panel designation scheme 中的 type、serial numbers 及正確 port position 完全一致。

Product data 適用條件：

- Three hours of storage at ambient temperature followed by 90 minutes of warm-up operation。
- Specified environmental conditions met。
- Recommended calibration interval adhered to。
- All internal automatic adjustments performed, if applicable。

資料定義依來源：specifications with limits 表示 warranted product performance；typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 non-traceable specifications with limits 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Legacy RF | [[R&S CMW500]] for 2G/3G continuity | [[Anritsu MT8821C]] needed even for most LTE cases | Anritsu LTE RF statement 未有官方文件佐證 |
| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]] / [[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMW100 K06]] | MT8000A + MD8475B + MT8821C + MT8870A + MT8862A separate ecosystems；另 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 補出 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 與 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] / [[MX819020A]] 的 virtual signalling path | source 未展開 MT8870A，也未提供完整 Anritsu production flow 文件 |
